title: Console: look up a PNR and import it
caption: Mirrors tools/e2e/specs/ota-admin/pnr-import.e2e.ts (console.bookings.findByRecordLocator, console.bookings.import; src/console/pnr-import.service.ts). Office isolation decides which orders an OTA may see.

steps.title: Look up
steps.body: Type the record locator of an order made in the Amadeus terminal (or the stub) for this OTA's office.
steps.expect: `GET /v1/console/bookings/by-record-locator?recordLocator=…` → the order with "Import as a booking"; `staff_actions` `pnr.lookup` (audited read); `supplier_requests` row.

steps.title: Import
steps.body: Import with a reason and a pricing mode (markup rules, net, override).
steps.expect: `POST /v1/console/bookings/imports` → `201` booking `channel = import`, status from the order (`confirmed`, `partially_ticketed`, `ticketed` or `cancelled`), `ticketing_status` `issued` / `partially_issued`, or `manual_review` for an order without tickets (the ticketing job never takes it); no payment (`paymentStatus = not_applicable`); staff action `booking.import`, event `booking.imported`. An optional `note` becomes a `staff.note` event, stored as typed (no card-number check).

steps.title: Import twice
steps.body: Import the same record locator again.

steps.title: Another OTA's office
steps.body: Look up a record locator owned by another OTA's office (e.g. the demo OTA's).
steps.expect: `403 OFFICE_NOT_ALLOWED` ("This record locator belongs to an office outside this OTA."); nothing of the order shown.
